name: How can I prevent my water heater from leaking?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent my water heater from leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Regular maintenance is key to preventing water heater leaks. This includes annual flushing of the tank to remove sediment buildup, which can cause corrosion and reduce efficiency. Periodically check the T&P relief valve and inspect connections for any signs of wear or corrosion. Ensuring proper water pressure in your home can also help prevent stress on the tank and components.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent leaks with regular maintenance like annual tank flushing to remove sediment. Also, check the T&P valve and plumbing connections, and ensure proper water pressure.
